title: Genesis Trust Framework
heading: Genesis Trust Framework
tagline_html: A public registry that demonstrates trust, not one that declares it.
thesis_html:
A transparency framework applicable to multiple digital projects: principles,
    requirements, controls, evidence, risks and decisions published as
    verifiable records — not as promises. Each project that applies it has
    its own Trust Center, with a score computed solely from its own registry.

sections.heading: What it demonstrates
sections.body_html: The framework structures trust into typed records validated against a schema: principles, regulatory requirements, controls, evidence, risks and decisions. Every control declared active must be verifiable by anyone, with published instructions — not a claim, but a way to check it. From these records, and only from these, the Open Trust Score is computed: ten indicators, each n/a until the data to compute it actually exists, never estimated.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.body_html: A generic engine (core/) and a separate registry for each project that applies it (tenants/<id>/): same schemas, same formulas, same generator — different data. No page on this site is written by hand: both the page you are reading and each project's Trust Center are generated from a public registry and a public configuration, verifiable in the source code.

footer_note_html: Genesis Trust Framework is an engine developed by Tangram.page; Spazio Genesi ETS applies it to its own services as a technology partner, providing the infrastructure it runs on. This page is generated automatically from content/site.config.en.json and a summary of each project's registry — see the source code.
